snippet.title: Norigin - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description: Get your first proper look at Norigin, an upcoming cinematic boss-climbing narrative game with a beautiful art style that's about family and self-discovery. Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2135000/Norigin/
